title: Completed localization of actual chart sections
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring, C its maximal-ideal adic completion, U open in Spec A, q:Y → U, s:E → Spec C, E affine, and D the supplied overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let t ∈ ℕ and f:Fin t → A with D(f_i) contained in U and V_i=(q followed by U inclusion)⁻¹D(f_i) affine. Use the fixed completed and chart section modules [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules]. There exist A-linear alpha_i:(Γ(E,top))_(f_i) ≃ C tensor_A M_i and additive d_i:C tensor_A M_i ≃ Γ(O,p⁻¹V_i), where O=Y ×_U (Spec C restricted to U), p:O → Y. The alpha_i commute with the localized C-action. Their generator values satisfy d_i(alpha_i(m/1))=restriction of D.toCompleted^*(m), and d_i(1 tensor n)=p^*n. Also d_i(z x)=the structural C-section of z times d_i(x). The alpha_i and d_i are constructed together, not supplied arbitrarily.

proof.text: For each chart V, paste the pullback over U with the restriction square to obtain a pullback over Spec A. Apply Mathlib isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen and isIso_pushoutSection_iff to the affine opens top, top, and V. Transport the section pushout along the two ΓSpecIso identifications, then use CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct and isoIsPushout to construct a ring equivalence Q from C tensor_A Γ(Y,V) to overlap sections. The inl and inr equations give the structural C-section and chart pullback generator formulas. chartSectionModule_smul identifies the original chart action with the structural A-action; baseChange of this identity gives the C-linear equivalence d.

D.over implies toCompleted followed by s is the overlap structural morphism. D.overlap_base identifies the chart inverse image with the inverse image of W=s⁻¹D(φ(f)). Since D(f) lies in U, W lies in the opensRange of the open immersion toCompleted; Hom.isIso_app therefore makes its section map, transported along the equality of opens, an isomorphism F. Naturality proves F respects the structural C-actions.

For affine E, W equals E.basicOpen of the structural image of φ(f). IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen makes Γ(E,W) a localization of Γ(E,top). Restrict along A and use IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv to construct e from the specified localized completed section module. Its generator equation is linearEquiv_apply. To verify e respects the localized C-action, compare the two A-linear maps by IsLocalizedModule.ext; on m/1 the assertion is multiplicativity of restriction. LocalizedModule.induction_on and exists_localized_s_module.choose_spec identify the localized scalar action with the localized multiplication map.

Define alpha=e followed by F followed by d inverse, restricting the C-linear composite to A. Its scalar identity follows from that of e and C-linearity. Cancellation of d with its inverse, linearEquiv_apply, and naturality of toCompleted prove the completed generator formula. The inr generator equation gives d(1 tensor m), and C-linearity gives d_scalar. Choose these jointly constructed pairs for every index. The argument has no nonempty-open or nonzero-element assumptions, so also covers f=0, empty charts, and the empty index family.
